notes: Single focused competency: place the mailing-list manager configuration in the canonical file (/etc/postfix/virtual_lists), make postfix honor it (postconf virtual_alias_maps + postmap), manage a delimited alias block with postalias, provision local accounts, and emit a report. The deliverable is a general idempotent installer reused verbatim against hidden list files (different domains/targets/accounts), and the verifier proves the canonical path is honored via postfix's own lookup tooling after a full state reset. Small nonzero rubric for the dependency chain, postfix tooling breadth, local-vs-external logic, adversarial reset/idempotency probing, hidden generalization and exact mapping correctness; totals bucket to medium.
